body:
Founder real-time: add ministrone to GFD too, same session as matching SHANKPIT/BIG_O additions. GFD's food system is a separate, pre-existing, real FFXI-inspired Go stat-buff registry (server/food/food.go) -- unrelated codebase, no hardcoded item count, so this was a pure addition. VIT+3/MND+4/HP+35, 25-min duration, same register as the existing Crab Soup but vegetable-themed. New TestMinestroneStats; full server/food suite (14/14), go build/vet clean. Commit 01abf7f.

⚓ ☃
title: Add MINESTRONE food item (server/food)
